status: Frozen pre-registration (Part 1 §3). Values listed in leadRulingPending are proposed and await the lead's ruling; a change to any value after the first measurement run is a new version (p-v2).
hypothesis: H1: on checkpointed multi-app tasks, B+P (per-step gate checkpoints plus one retry from the last verified checkpoint) verifies more tasks than B (one end-state gate check, no checkpoints, no retry). H0: no increase. One-sided.

B+P.surface: B plus the cross-app-steps family's per-step gate checkpoints and #514's one retry from the last verified checkpoint

B.surface: base surface B: the same tasks, one gate check on the end state only, no checkpoints, no retry

arms.baseSurface: C1 (capability-spec-2 §1.3: B is C1 until a Part 1 bar is shown). Both arms run in the same Ultra harness; their tool lists differ by exactly the treatment. hcu+shell is not a bar component here (parity, Part 1 §1.3); any comparison against it is a reported secondary.

conformanceSet.role: plumbing and conformance only; never part of the bar

assignment: One scored trial per (task, arm). Tasks shuffled by the assignment seed (Fisher-Yates over mulberry32 seeded from sha256(seed)), then arms in ABBA blocks over consecutive tasks. A trial's ordinal must equal its slot in that schedule (scripts/cross-app-prereg.ts schedule).

model.plan: Claude Ultra (Claude Code subscription): $0 Anthropic API, no Messages-API calls

primaryMetric: Verified rate (Part 1 §1.1, gated rows): a done claim, the gate's end-state verdict verified (and, in B+P, the last checkpoint verified), and every step snapshot and the end state graded pass by the independent grader (src/benchmark/grade/cross-app.ts). A grader pass the gate did not verify is reported as 'correct, not accepted'.

components.test: exact one-sided McNemar (sign test on discordant tasks)
components.shownIf: p <= 0.05 with at least 5 discordant tasks

components.metric: steps per verified task (total steps over ALL trials / verified trials)
components.test: paired bootstrap over tasks, 10,000 resamples, bootstrap seed
components.shownIf: one-sided 95% upper bound of B+P/B below 1.0

guardrails: Zero gate false-verifieds over all B+P trials (gate end verdict verified while any step or end grade is fail or ungradable); one fails the bar.
Masked-step tasks (step k wrong in its own snapshot, fixed later) grade fail: a later step never masks an earlier failure.
Every step oracle passes R5's self-test on its claimed classes.
On the sealed-vault path, a family whose extra files the vault does not capture returns uncertain (fail closed).
notShown: fewer than 5 discordant tasks ('underpowered at n', with the discordant count)
a parity or assignment check failed
refused: the pack's pre-registration hash does not match this file's hash
the pack's task set or manifest digest differs
any simulated row (planner not the pre-registered model id, or marked simulated)

secondary: the step at which failures first occur
steps, wall time and cost per verified task (cost a token-derived estimate over ALL trials; null never 0)
evidence: Experiment rows only, never R1 evidence (capability-spec-2 §1.5). Simulated rows never count. No run until the lead's GO for track P.
leadRulingPending: xa-v2 (40 tasks) as the bar's task set, keeping #535's xa-v1 as conformance (capability-spec-2 §6 'P'); #535's own bar (src/benchmark/cross-app-bar.ts: xa-v1 x 10 repetitions, Newcombe, 0.10 margin) is not this bar
B gets one end-state gate check so both arms are gated rows (capability-spec-2 §P, builder alignment (c)); #535's baseline arm is gate-less
one-sided vs two-sided tests across tracks (capability-spec-2 §6)
step budget 30 (Part 1 §1.3 default; P names none) for a three-step, two-app task with one retry
planner model id claude-sonnet-5-5 (the pilot's PILOT_MODEL on Ultra)
power: at n = 40 the bar is underpowered for net gains of about 10-15 points (Part 1 §1.5 power table)
